heroHeadline: Fukushima at 15: ALPS Discharge Surpasses 133,000 m³; TEPCO Achieves First Commercial Nuclear Power Since 2011
heroSubtitle: TEPCO's Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Unit 6 resumed commercial operations April 16, 2026 — the company's first commercial nuclear power in 15 years. The 19th round of ALPS-treated water ocean discharge was completed in April. An April 20 earthquake triggered precautionary evacuations at both Fukushima plants; no abnormalities detected. IAEA Task Force (May 11–15) confirmed continued compliance with international safety standards.
footerNote: Data sourced from TEPCO, Japan NRA, IAEA, NHK, Fukushima Prefecture, UNSCEAR, and peer-reviewed health studies. Last comprehensive update: May 2026.
